ambient_events: The overflow weir trickles into black water that has nowhere left to go.
Your light finds something metal glinting under the surface, then loses it.
The chamber holds your smallest sound and hands it back doubled.
description: A dead-end overflow chamber, half-drowned, where the storm system dumps its excess and forgets it. Flotsam has collected here for years against the weir — and with it, whatever the current stole from the streets above and carried down. A patient scavenger does well in a room like this.
name: Overflow Chamber
